title: Opaque Multi-Environment Monolith Config Files
damaged_code:
```yaml
# app_config.yaml
development:
  db_host: "localhost"
production:
  db_host: "10.0.0.5" # Live in same file; typo here breaks production
```
pattern: Consolidating configurations for development, testing, staging, and production inside a single file parsed by all environments.
why_bad: Exposes production topology details and keys to developers in local environments. It makes the configuration overly complex and ensures that a typo added during local development can bring down production.
detection: A single configuration schema or file containing distinct keys representing active operational profiles or deployment tiers.
counterexample:
```yaml
# config.yaml (only the schema structure; real properties are injected per environment)
db_host: "${DB_HOST}"
```
fix: Separate environment profiles into distinct physical files; load only the specific configuration matching the active execution container at runtime.
source: [Pragmatic Programmers] Michael T. Nygard - *Release It!_ Design and Deploy Production-Ready Software* (2007, Pragmatic Bookshelf).pdf, Section 14.2.
